# Source-aware Ultra admission successor

The v7 columns are source-only hypotheses for bounded complete-source Ultra.
Every historical v6 row and original request/source/selector column is retained.
All 27 strategy-8 tuples are independently resolved from pinned source tables;
valid out-of-envelope Ultra requests become resource-limited, and strategy 9
remains unsupported. Existing successful classifications are preserved.

Generate only into a fresh directory with `scripts/check_reference_admission_v7.py
--write`; normal and optimized `--check` must reproduce every byte. Provenance
records immutable predecessor hashes, exact changed rows, malformed-input
rejections and zero child execution. This projection does not enable public Ultra
or substitute for native bidirectional complete-frame qualification.
